conditions_echo: Unsupervised, individual, AI-permitted take-home summative assessment, sent home over a week at the end of Unit 4; the numbers and problems are new to the students, but the item types have been practiced.
reviewer_notes: All three claims are well-targeted by their items -- the gap is identical and singular across the assessment: it is administered unsupervised with AI permitted, so no item's response can be attributed to the student, not that any item asks for the wrong thing. A short (2-3 minute) supervised check per claim, using the same item types already on the take-home, would recover the missing independent evidence at low cost. The take-home itself can still be used for practice or completion purposes, just not as the basis for the summative conclusion about individual mastery.
